kinds.d: Cardboard box sold flat for packing or moving; storage boxes are in Furniture & Storage.
Wide adhesive tape for sealing parcels and boxes.
Hand dispenser with a cutting edge that lays parcel tape on boxes.
Plastic sheet of air bubbles for cushioning goods.
Loose fill, paper, air pillows or foam packed round goods in a box.

notes: Five kinds from six: Void fill and Foam packing merged into Packing fill (types: loose fill, paper, air pillows, foam sheet and corners). Stretch film and strapping were not in this shelf's old data; per the brief they are trade/warehouse supplies and stay out.
